title: fix(connectAutoComplete): allow usage with hits from a single index (algolia/react-instantsearch#75)
explanation: This GitHub issue appears to be a fix for a bug in the 'connectAutoComplete' component of the 'react-instantsearch' library, which allows the component to work with hits from a single index. The issue body expresses appreciation for the fix and includes the necessary changes, indicating a positive sentiment with gratitude towards the resolution of the issue.
